title: Project Connect: Grants, Design, Construction
summary:
*   **Austin Transit Future:** City leaders will attend a Capital Metro board meeting focused on the Project Connect transit initiative.
*   **Federal Grants & Design:** Key discussions will cover securing federal funding and reviewing the project's design and environmental plans.
*   **Construction Options:** The meeting will explore potential strategies for procuring construction services for the major transit project.
*   **Information Session Only:** This is an informational work session, and the City Council will not be taking any formal actions or votes.
